mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 5.0%, the market prices in an imminent monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market level above 130 million persons (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates a strong economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion (HOUST > 600), the S&P 500 benefits from strong consumer spending and construction activity, generating positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicate a persistent inflationary environment that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when both CPIAUCSL exceeds 220 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
